description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'ThingCommandFactory' responsible for creating commands to retrieve 'Thing' objects via the 'SudoRetrieveThing' command. It includes methods for generating such commands based on 'EntityId' or 'ThingId', incorporating optional cache lookup context and generating correlation IDs.

classes.name: ThingCommandFactory
classes.description: A final utility class that creates commands to access the 'Things' service, specifically generating 'SudoRetrieveThing' commands based on provided identifiers and cache context.

methods.name: sudoRetrieveThing
methods.description: Creates a sudo command for retrieving a thing, accepting either an 'EntityId' or a 'ThingId', with optional cache lookup context, and logs the operation.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Generates a UUID-based correlation ID, logs when a new ID is generated due to absence of an existing one.
